risks.risk: Shadow execution may fail despite successful local validation.
risks.detection: Preflight, telemetry, and per-stage error reports.
risks.mitigation: Abort on failed readiness checks and isolate candidate failures.
risks.rollback: Disable the evaluation run; production path remains unchanged.

risks.risk: Candidate recommendations may over-escalate editorial actions.
risks.mitigation: Apply constitution v1.1 and require human review.
risks.rollback: Discard candidate results and retain production decision.

risks.risk: Sensitive source text could leak into evaluation reports.
risks.detection: Redaction tests and sanitized report inspection.
risks.mitigation: Disable raw outputs and require input redaction.
risks.rollback: Stop evaluation, quarantine report, and rotate exposed secrets if any.

risks.risk: An operator may run with inconsistent environment settings.
risks.mitigation: Abort before model execution on every failed check.
risks.rollback: Clear transient environment and rerun validation only.

risks.risk: A small or synthetic dataset may not represent production behavior.
risks.mitigation: Treat results as shadow evidence only and expand reviewed fixtures.
risks.rollback: Classify evidence as inconclusive and do not advance.

risks.risk: Evaluation approval could be mistaken for production approval.
risks.detection: Manifest candidate-use field and release review.
risks.mitigation: Label candidate EVALUATION_ONLY and prohibit production eligibility language.
risks.rollback: Revoke certification and issue corrected governance record.

risks.risk: Shadow requests may exceed expected token or request budgets.
risks.detection: Request ceilings and returned token telemetry.
risks.mitigation: Set conservative ceilings and stop when exhausted.
risks.rollback: Stop the run; no automatic retry beyond configured limits.

risks.risk: Candidate behavior may change after provider-side model updates.
risks.detection: Record actual model version and compare recurring fixtures.
risks.mitigation: Pin identifiers where possible and require repeated certification.
risks.rollback: Disable candidate evaluation and retain production model.

risks.risk: Fixture changes may invalidate comparability with historical reports.
risks.detection: Dataset and fixture version compatibility validation.
risks.mitigation: Version fixtures and reject incompatible report combinations.
risks.rollback: Replay with the matching historical fixture version.

risks.risk: Policy changes may silently alter adjusted recommendations.
risks.detection: Constitution pinning and policy-only replay diffs.
risks.mitigation: Version constitutions and preserve raw model decisions.
risks.rollback: Select the previous reviewed constitution without rewriting history.

risks.risk: Review volume or ambiguity may exceed operator capacity.
risks.detection: Additional-review rate and queue aging metrics.
risks.mitigation: Staff reviewers, prioritize blocking findings, and retain normal review.
risks.rollback: Pause shadow evaluation without changing production decisions.
